svg.aria-label: Cut Planner: plans cuts from bars and sheets with the least waste. Animation: the frame profiles of a fictional order of 11 windows cut by hand, longest piece first, need 14 bars ($462); Cut Planner's plan needs 13 bars ($420), proven to be the least possible.
svg.title: Cut Planner
svg.text: Plans the cuts from bars and sheets with the
least waste: cutting diagrams to print, the cut
list, offcuts worth keeping, and the money saved
compared with cutting by hand. Tested on 1,615
benchmark jobs with proven optimal answers.
